name: Pennsylvania
notes: Season dates are taken from the PA Game Commission 2026-27 seasons page, the final 2026-27 seasons release and the Hunting & Trapping Digest.

County → WMU is derived by overlaying county boundaries (US Census) on the official PGC WMU map. Shares under 1% are omitted; shares under 5% are labeled "small part". Confirm your WMU in the digest map.

rules.title: Licenses
rules.text: Hunting licenses are valid July 1–June 30. Antlerless deer licenses are separate and allocated by WMU (sales began June 22; round 4 limits: 6 per hunter, 15 in WMUs 5C/5D). Waterfowl hunters need a PA Migratory Game Bird License plus a federal duck stamp (age 16+).

rules.title: Legal hunting hours
rules.text: Generally ½ hour before sunrise to ½ hour after sunset (see the digest hours table for exceptions such as spring turkey, furbearers and migratory birds).

rules.title: Sunday hunting
rules.text: All 2026-27 seasons include Sundays except migratory game birds (no Sunday hunting) and the 2026 spring gobbler season. Sunday spring turkey begins in 2027.

rules.title: Fluorescent orange
rules.text: Firearms deer seasons: 250 sq in of fluorescent orange on head, chest and back, visible 360°. Not required for archery-only deer, flintlock season, or fall turkey. Archers must wear it during firearms deer seasons and the October antlerless muzzleloader season. State Game Lands: orange required Oct 1–Jan 31 and Apr 20–May 31 for anyone not hunting, trapping or fishing.

rules.title: Antler restrictions
rules.text: Most of the state: 3 points on one side. WMUs 1A, 1B, 2A, 2B & 2D: "three up". Juniors, mentored youth, disabled-permit hunters and active-duty military may take deer with 2+ points on one antler or a spike ≥3 in. Seniors must follow the restrictions. 1 antlered deer per license year.

rules.title: Firearms limits
rules.text: No semi-automatic rifles for deer, bear or elk. Semi-automatic shotguns loaded with single-projectile ammunition are allowed. Shotguns used for small game, turkey and waterfowl are limited to 3 shells total.

rules.title: Baiting
rules.text: Baiting is prohibited statewide. A conditional exception exists in the Southeast Special Regulations Area — see digest p. 13.

county_notes.Erie County: Waterfowl: the Lake Erie Zone covers Lake Erie, Presque Isle and the area within 150 yards of the shoreline; the rest of Erie County is in the Northwest Zone.
county_notes.Crawford County: Waterfowl: all of Crawford County is in the Northwest Zone.
county_notes.Mercer County: Waterfowl: the part of Mercer County north of I-80 is in the Northwest Zone; check the digest for the rest.
county_notes.Venango County: Waterfowl: the part of Venango County north of I-80 is in the Northwest Zone; check the digest for the rest.
